Blind-fight.description: At 1st level, an eye of Gruumsh receives Blind-Fight as a bonus feat. Furthermore, losing one eye imposes no penalties on him.

Blinding Spittle.description: From 4th level onward, an eye of Gruumsh can spit caustic stomach acid at a target within 20 feet. This requires a successful ranged touch attack with a -4 penalty. A target that fails a Reflex save (DC 10 + eye of Gruumsh class level + Constitution modifier) is blinded until the acid is washed from its eyes. Creatures without eyes or that do not rely on sight are immune. This ability can be used twice per day at 4th level and four times per day at 7th level.

Blindsight.description: At 5th level, an eye of Gruumsh acquires blindsight with a range of 5 feet. This range extends to 10 feet upon reaching 8th level.

Command the Horde.description: An eye of Gruumsh can command any nongood orcs or half-orcs within 30 feet whose Hit Dice are below his character level. Creatures that obey his orders receive a +2 morale bonus on Will saves. If an eligible orc or half-orc deliberately defies the eye of Gruumsh's commands, this bonus is lost immediately.

Rage.description: An eye of Gruumsh gains the ability to rage, functioning identically to the barbarian rage with all associated benefits and penalties. His eye of Gruumsh levels stack with any barbarian levels for the purpose of determining how many times per day he may rage. To calculate daily uses, combine levels from both classes and consult the class table. For instance, a barbarian 6/eye of Gruumsh 2 would rage three times per day (matching a barbarian of 8th level), while an eye of Gruumsh 4 with no barbarian levels would rage twice per day (matching a 4th-level barbarian).

Ritual Scarring.description: By repeatedly scarring his own flesh, an eye of Gruumsh increases his natural armor bonus by +1 at 3rd level (or gains a +1 natural armor bonus if he had none). This bonus improves by an additional +1 for every three eye of Gruumsh levels gained after that.

Sight of Gruumsh.description: Upon reaching 10th level, an eye of Gruumsh receives a vision of his own death through his missing eye. This prophetic insight grants him a permanent +2 morale bonus to all saving throws and Armor Class. Additionally, he no longer falls unconscious when reduced to negative hit points, though he still dies at -10 hit points. The mechanical benefit applies regardless of whether the vision ultimately proves accurate, as the character fully believes in what he has seen.

Swing Blindly.description: Starting at 2nd level, an eye of Gruumsh's rage grows fiercer but leaves him more exposed. While raging, he gains an additional +4 bonus to Strength, but his Armor Class penalty worsens from -2 to -4.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: This prestige class does not grant proficiency with any weapons or armor.

This attack has no effect on creatures that don't have eyes or don't depend on vision. Blinding spittle is usable twice per day at 4th level and four times per day at 7th level.
